originalPrompt:
A cobot operates near humans. Which feature provides physical impact-energy
       absorption, independent of software safety limits?
originalSourceText:
Q.10 A cobot operates near humans. Which feature provides physical impact-energy
       absorption, independent of software safety limits?

      (A) Redundant sensing

      (B) Mechanical compliance

      (C) Safety-rated zones

      (D) Emergency-stop logic

       Explanation: Soft joints and back-drivable actuators provide mechanical compliance
        that absorbs impact energy.

      Refer slide16 of lecture 60: Application Domains, Ethics, Safety, Future of AI
       Robotics, Course Review & Career Pathways
